summary: Iteration 3 bug-fix cycle verified end-to-end. Backend pytest: 12/12 pass (health, reviews x8, questions public seeded 8 + ordered, /questions/all auth guard, questions CRUD create->public visible, update->inactive drops from public, soft delete, survey submit accepts new shape {name,phone,email(empty ok),answers[]}, admin /survey/list returns docs with answers[] intact, ALL 4 /api/vacancies* routes 404). issues: Accessibility console warning: 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle for the component to be accessible for screen reader users.' SurveyDialog.js does not render a <DialogTitle>. Wrap the heading in <DialogTitle> or add a VisuallyHidden DialogTitle to silence the a11y violation.

action_items: (Low) Add a DialogTitle (or VisuallyHidden DialogTitle) inside SurveyDialog's DialogContent to fix the Radix a11y console warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 324: logger.info(f"New survey submission: {doc['email']} ({doc['intent']})") — both fields are now Optional; log will read 'None (None)' for typical new-shape submissions. Cosmetic only, but consider logging len(answers) instead.
SurveyDialog.js has no <DialogTitle>; Radix logs an accessibility error on every open. Low-risk but violates a11y contract.
server.py is ~570 lines with routes+models+auth+storage all inline — recommend splitting into routers (auth, survey, questions, updates, files) at next refactor pass.
CORS still allow_origins='*' with allow_credentials=False — fine for current public API, but must be tightened before adding cookies/JWT-in-cookie.
/api/files/{path} silently checks 3 collections; a small helper or index would make it clearer and faster.
